contributions.en: Fixed five test regressions on main introduced after #316, #318, #319, and #322.
contributions.zh: 修复 #316、#318、#319、#322 合入后 main 分支上的五项测试回归。

contributions.en: Upgraded CI build and test workflows from Python 3.10 to Python 3.12.
contributions.zh: 将 CI 构建与测试工作流从 Python 3.10 升级至 Python 3.12。

contributions.en: Eliminated undefined-behavior negative left shifts in the C++ alignment kernel (cpp/openfocus_ab.cpp).
contributions.zh: 消除 C++ 对齐内核（cpp/openfocus_ab.cpp）中在 UBSan 下触发未定义行为的负数左移。

contributions.en: Aligned AVX2 and scalar C++ kernel outputs when working buffers partially overlap.
contributions.zh: 统一 C++ 内核缓冲区部分重叠时 AVX2 与标量路径的计算结果。

contributions.en: Stopped GUI startup from automatically opening a browser sign-in tab on every launch, including headless and automated runs.
contributions.zh: 修复桌面端每次启动（含无头与自动化运行场景）都会自动弹出浏览器登录页的问题。

contributions.en: Fixed retouch replay source fallback, soft-blend stabiliser axis, prototype tool invocation, and unavailable temp-folder feedback.
contributions.zh: 修复修饰重放源帧回退、柔和融合稳定器轴向、原型工具调用以及临时目录不可用时的交互提示。

contributions.en: Clipped watermark previews to opaque regions instead of drawing over transparent areas of transparent outputs.
contributions.zh: 修复透明输出图像中水印预览错误绘制到透明区域的问题。

contributions.en: Moved renders into a crash-isolated worker process so a native fault no longer closes the main application window.
contributions.zh: 将渲染任务隔离到独立工作进程，避免底层原生故障导致主窗口闪退。

contributions.en: Bundled certifi CA certificates across macOS desktop HTTPS clients so TLS verification succeeds out of the box.
contributions.zh: 为 macOS 桌面端所有 HTTPS 客户端统一打包 certifi 根证书库，解决缺少 CA 证书导致的请求失败。

contributions.en: Fixed macOS v2.0.0 desktop sign-in remaining stuck on the sign-in screen after a successful browser OAuth callback.
contributions.zh: 修复 macOS v2.0.0 在浏览器完成 OAuth 回调后桌面端仍停留在登录界面的问题。

contributions.en: Implemented the paper's Gaussian-like four-neighborhood gradient (GFG) operator in GFG-FGF instead of simple mean difference.
contributions.zh: 将 GFG-FGF 算法从均值差分修正为论文中的类高斯四邻域梯度（GFG）算子。

contributions.en: Fixed packaged windowed builds crashing with "I/O operation on closed file" during rendering when stdout/stderr are closed.
contributions.zh: 修复无控制台打包版本在渲染时因标准输出关闭导致的 "I/O operation on closed file" 崩溃。

contributions.en: Fixed packaged-build Stack-MFF-V4 rendering crash ("NoneType object has no attribute 'write'").
contributions.zh: 修复打包版本运行 Stack-MFF-V4 时触发 "NoneType object has no attribute 'write'" 的崩溃问题。
